title: Article 129 — Supreme Court to be a court of record

content.overview: Article 129 provides that the Supreme Court shall be a court of record and shall have all the powers of such a court including the power to punish for contempt of itself.
content.glance: Supreme Court is a court of record and may punish for contempt of itself.
content.study:
Article 129 declares the Supreme Court a court of record and expressly includes the power to punish for contempt of itself. As a court of record, its acts and proceedings are recorded for perpetual memory and testimony, and it has inherent powers associated with that status.

Examination: court of record; contempt power.

sections.heading: Key rule
sections.body: The Supreme Court is a court of record and has all the powers of such a court, including the power to punish for contempt of itself.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 129 provide?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 129 provides that the Supreme Court shall be a court of record and shall have all the powers of such a court including the power to punish for contempt of itself.

keyTakeaways: Art 129: SC is a court of record with contempt power.
